Rules & hints

Quick guide

How to play

Everything you need to get your campus quest started.

One word connects the pictures

Look at all four picture clues and work out the word they have in common. Tap letters on the randomized keyboard to fill each slot. Tap a filled slot to remove its letter; the puzzle checks your answer once all the slots are filled.

Your toolbar

Use hint: reveals a random letter. You can hold up to three hints; solving a level refills them. Find a building’s treasure or finish the daily quests to earn bonus hints. Swap pictures: shuffles the clues without changing the keyboard. Tap a filled answer slot to edit a guess.

Unlock the map

Solve each puzzle to reveal that building on the map and collect its campus map piece in your wallet. Levels unlock in order; select an unlocked building to travel there, play again, learn more, or answer its trivia. Find hidden treasure puzzles at buildings and complete three daily exploration quests for extra hints.

Level 1

The first puzzle's answer is a seven-letter word connected to books and the library. Can you find it using the pictures?
